# uup_notification_rule (Data Source)

Looks up a Notification rule by its `id` or its `name`, or the Project's Default rule with `default = true`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The Project's Default rule, which every new Monitor gets.
data "uup_notification_rule" "default" {
  project_id = data.uup_project.main.id
  default    = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) The Project the rule belongs to, `prj_…`.

### Optional

- `default` (Boolean) Set to `true` to find the Project's Default rule.
- `id` (String) The rule's identifier, `rul_…`.
- `name` (String) The rule's name.

### Read-Only

- `channel_ids` (Set of String) Its Channels, `chn_…`.
- `event_types` (Set of String) The events it sends, or null for every event.
- `repeat` (String) How often an open Incident is sent again, or `off`.
- `warnings_during_outage` (Boolean) Whether warnings are sent while an outage is open.
